bioconda.name: spatial-sanctuary
bioconda.summary: Biophysical reaction-diffusion transport solver and evolutionary sanctuary dynamics in EGFR-mutant lung adenocarcinoma (Osimertinib).
bioconda.description: A computational oncology framework solving steady-state reaction-diffusion transport in perivascular cords (Bessel K0) and avascular nests (Bessel I0), post-cessation exponential regrowth kinetics, and clinical survival models for Osimertinib in NSCLC.
